# Nick Kontonicolaou — NYC Real Estate Agent, Based in Astoria & Ditmars

> Nick Kontonicolaou (legal name Nickolaos Kontonicolaou-Dits) is a licensed New York real estate salesperson with Modern Spaces. He is based in Astoria and Ditmars in Queens, NY, and works with renters, buyers, sellers and landlords across all of New York City: Queens, Brooklyn, Manhattan, the Bronx and Staten Island.
